messages:
maya.k: Heads-up — ProcureMate sent an updated pilot pricing and a short responses doc. Can we quick sync on negotiation levers?
aj: tl;dr?
maya.k: They quoted parsing at $0.03/per invoice, $0.01/per line item, plus $500/mo for connectors. Pilot estimated 50k invoices/mo. They offered a one-month pilot credit but want a 6‑mo commit for the volume price.
sofia: 50k/mo is our medium case. What does committed pricing look like vs overage?
maya.k: Committed tiers: 0-25k $0.05, 25k-75k $0.03, 75k+ $0.02. Overages billed at committed rate until next billing cycle.
liam: That tier shape looks fine but curious about accuracy SLAs and dispute credits — do they have NPS or FDR numbers?
maya.k: They claim 98.5% line-item extraction accuracy and 99% date/vendor extraction. They offered SLA credits: 10% credit for <97% monthly accuracy, 25% credit for <95%.
aj: Does that credit apply to parse fees only or all line items?
maya.k: Parse fees only. Connector fee not refundable.
sofia: Need to confirm support for multi-PO invoices and EDI 810. Also data residency for EU customers.
maya.k: Jordan says EDI 810 is on roadmap; they can do schema mapping in pilot but not native EDI yet. For EU data residency they can route through eu-region stack for an extra $200/mo.
jordan (ProcureMate): Hey team — happy to clarify. We can include a pilot extension (up to 2 months) for integration work and add a 60‑day rollback if commit not met. Regarding EDI, we can provide a managed mapping service during pilot.
liam: @jordan — what's the tempo for support? Dedicated TAM or shared?
jordan (ProcureMate): Shared TAM during pilot. Dedicated TAM included after annual commitment.
sofia: Ok, red flags: 1) connector fee non-refundable, 2) overage billing at committed rate could blow costs for spikes, 3) EDI not native yet.
aj: For negotiation levers: ask to refund connector fee pro-rated if we cancel within 90 days, cap overage at 20% above commit for first 3 months, and include a 1‑month free connector setup for pilot.
maya.k: Good list. Also request SCIM + SSO in writing and a short runbook for failback if parsing regresses.
jordan (ProcureMate): We can do pro‑rated connector refund and 1 month free setup for pilot. SCIM/SSO is standard — will include in contract. Overage cap is something I need to escalate.
finance-bot: Billing note: if we accept a 6‑mo commit we need PO workflow and a Revenue Ops ticket; recommend finance review cap and refund language prior to signature.
liam: Recommend pilot acceptance if they agree to pro‑rated connector refund + pilot extension + accuracy baseline check after 2 weeks. Finance to confirm legal language on rollback.
sofia: Approved to proceed with vendor meeting on Tuesday. Maya, can you run a 30‑minute vendor Q&A focused on EDI, overage cap, and SLA calculation?
maya.k: Yep — scheduled Tues 10am PT. I'll include a short sample dataset for them to run. Thanks all :thumbsup:
